procedure_name: Trade Union Registration under Trade Unions Act
summary: Registration conferring statutory legal status and collective bargaining rights to representative worker associations.

steps.title: Adopt constitution & bylaws
steps.description: Draft constitution containing union objectives, membership fees, executive committee rules, and election intervals.

steps.title: Gather minimum 7 subscribing members
steps.description: Ensure minimum 10% or 100 workers (whichever is less) are enrolled as active members.

steps.title: Submit Form A application
steps.description: Submit application to Registrar of Trade Unions with details of office-bearers, addresses, and parent establishment.

steps.title: Verification of member consent
steps.description: Labour officer verifies signatures and confirms absence of duplicate competing union registrations.

steps.title: Issuance of Registration Certificate
steps.description: Receive Certificate of Registration in Form B with permanent registration number.
